headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: NBCC (India) Limited (NBCC) reported a strong Q2FY27, with growth in both revenue and profitability.
Revenue from operations was INR 3,396 cr, up 16.5% YoY and 50.3% QoQ, led by strong standalone execution, where revenue grew 37.8% YoY to INR 2,890 cr.
EBITDA margin rose to 6.6%, up 300 bps YoY and down 30 bps QoQ.
The margin gain came from marketing fee income on redevelopment asset sales and operating leverage on a largely fixed cost base.
valuation: FY27 inflow guidance of INR 50,000-60,000 cr is maintained, led by 5 GPRA (INR 30,000-35,000 cr) and new state mandates from Bihar and West Bengal, with the order book targeted at INR 1.8 lakh cr by FY27 end.  Execution Ramp-Up in H2: Management expects INR 15,000-16,000 cr of works to be awarded over the next two quarters, including Supertech at INR 9,600 cr, which will contribute revenue from Q4.
The order book is targeted at INR 1.8 lakh cr by FY27 end.  Execution is the key watch point: Works awarded in H1 were INR 3,166 cr.
watch: Risks: Arranging funds, statutory clearance, aged receivables & domestic slowdown.
